26 (Currently Amended): A non-aqueous composition comprising: a therapeutically effective amount of a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), said NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in a non-aqueous carrier wherein the non-aqueous carrier comprises a bio-compatible oil and from 20 wt.% to 80 wt.% phosphatidylcholine; the NSAID to non-aqueous carrier weight ratio is about 5:1 to about 1:5; and the NSAID is an NSAID selected from the group consisting of propionic acid NSAIDs, acetic acid NSAIDs, and salicylic acid NSAIDs, wherein the phosphatidylcholine is present in an amount sufficient to reduce NSAID-associated gastro-intestinal ulceration and bleeding, and the therapeutic activity of the NSAID for treatment of tissue inflammation, pain and fever is preserved.

50 (Currently Amended): A non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition comprising a biocompatible oil carrier including phosphatidylcholine and salicylic acid NSAID, said salicylic acid NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in the biocompatible oil carrier, said composition having a weight ratio of salicylic acid NSAID to biocompatible oil of about 5:1 to about 1:5.

51 (Currently Amended): The non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition of claim 50 comprising from 10 wt % to 60 wt% phosphatidylcholine.
